[[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] served as '''royal guards''', and they were [[soldier]]s assigned to protect the [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]].

==History==
Two of these guards were assigned to protect [[Katuunko/Legends|King Katuunko]] during negotiations with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. They were wary of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] but did not attack her. When Ventress was ordered to kill Katuunko, they rushed to defend him but were [[Telekinesis/Legends#Applications|Force pushed]] and knocked unconscious. Eventually they awoke and joined [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and Katuunko in boarding a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]].

Later, they attempted to protect Katuunko from [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] when he landed at the palace to kidnap the King for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. All of the presiding guards, however, perished at Opress's hands.

Following the king's assassination, the royal guards formed an elite brigade dedicated to hunting down [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. The wielded [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]-lined scimitars and undertook mental training to resist Force powers.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
